stories.story_fr: Les prévisions de bénéfice par action dilué pour 2026 ont été relevées à 8,40 $‑8,50 $.
stories.story_en: Fiscal 2026 earnings per diluted share guidance was raised to $8.40‑$8.50.
stories.quote: Guidance raised to the range of $8.40 - $8.50 from $8.15 - $8.35 per diluted share.

stories.story_fr: Le dividende annuel a été porté à 4,00 $ soit une hausse de 14,9 %.
stories.story_en: The annual dividend was increased to $4.00, a 14.9% rise.
stories.quote: The indicated annual dividend for fiscal 2026 is $4.00, which represents a 14.9% increase over fiscal 2025.

stories.story_fr: Les dépenses d'investissement de 2,0 milliards $ sont 85 % dédiées à la sécurité et à la fiabilité.
stories.story_en: Capital expenditures of $2.0 billion were 85% focused on safety and reliability.
stories.quote: Capital expenditures were $2.0 billion over 85% focused on safety and reliability.

stories.story_en: Implemented $135.3 million in annualized regulatory outcomes.
stories.quote: Implemented $135.3 million in annualized regulatory outcomes.
